def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:

    valid_mask = remaining >= 0
    eps = 10 * np.finfo(float).eps

    # Base score based on remaining space and bin size
    log_remaining = np.log(remaining + eps)
    log_bins = np.log(bins + eps)
    base_score = -((remaining * (log_remaining - log_bins)).clip(0, item))

    norm_item = item + eps
    priority = base_score / norm_item

    # Boost for bins with more than half remaining space
    priority[remaining > 0.5 * item] += 15 / norm_item
    # Further boost for bins with very small remaining space (almost full)
    priority[remaining < 0.1 * item] += 25 / norm_item
    # Penalize bins with very large remaining space (wasteful)

    return priority

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:

                      r_percent * (1 - r_percent))

    full_penalty = -np.clip(r_percent, a_min=0, a_max=0.9) * valid_mask
    
    # Penalize bins with very small remaining space

    moderate_utilization = np.clip(r_percent, a_min=0.5, a_max=0.9) * valid_mask
